messages:
Marco: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — recurring KV cache eviction spike. We extracted 3 remediation items and need owners + jira IDs. Timeline: quick fixes (2w), rollout (8w). @Emma @Raj can you take infra/runtime ownership?
Emma: I can take the diagnostics and TTL tuning items. Will open JIRAs this morning. :white_check_mark:
Raj: I will own kernel fallback and canary plan. Need SRE for the staging window — pinging @Olivia
Olivia: SRE can own the canary and smoke tests. What are the ticket IDs once they're created?
Emma: Created INF-6523 (cache diagnostics) and INF-6524 (bloom TTL tuning). Assigned to me, due 2026-04-07. Link to notes in the doc later.
Raj: Created INF-6525 for runtime kernel fallback and canary config. @Luis can you review for perf/regression risk?
Luis: I'll review INF-6525, ETA EOD Thu. Proposed RACI: Emma (A), Raj (R), Olivia (C), Luis (I). Add Marco as I for rollout sign-off.
Marco: Sounds good — I'll be I for rollout sign-off and stakeholder comms. Let's lock a checkpoint next Wed to review status and test results. Also add incident-pattern tracking to the postmortem doc so we can spot recurrence.
Olivia: I will draft a pre-rollout smoke test checklist and attach it to the tickets. SRE needs that before scheduling canary.
Emma: Checklist attached to INF-6523 and INF-6524. Notes link: https://redwoodhq.internal/pm/pm-382/notes
Raj: Added a fallback flag to INF-6525 and a canary policy: auto-rollback if error rate >2%. CLI flag for runtime team: `--enable-fallback`
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for INF-6525 on staging — 2026-04-01 02:00 UTC. (created by deploy-bot)
Marco: :thumbsup: Great. I'll update the postmortem action tracker spreadsheet, add the RACI column, and create weekly check-ins. If anything slips, assign to the rotation pool and tag on-call.
Emma: One more note — diagnostics will include a load repro run and KV eviction trace. I'll post repro steps to the ticket by EOD.
Luis: After my review I'll add perf guardrails and a test matrix for sequence lengths that trip eviction.
Olivia: Once SRE runs the canary, we'll post the results as a short thread on the ticket — pass/fail + perf deltas.
Marco: Thanks team. Assignments recap: INF-6523 (Emma), INF-6524 (Emma), INF-6525 (Raj). RACI added to each ticket. Next checkpoint: 2026-03-31 16:00 UTC.
